name: Occlusion Clipping with Orthogonal Opacity Map
aliases: Empty Space Skipping and Occlusion Clipping
definition: A technique to skip occluded voxels by creating an orthogonal opacity map on a plane orthogonal to a major axis, updating it efficiently on the GPU, and using it to cull and clip sub-volumes.
summary: Occlusion Clipping with Orthogonal Opacity Map accelerates volume rendering by testing occlusion at the sub-volume level using a fixed-resolution map, unlike per-voxel methods.
